newsitem.title: BULGARIA: SOCCER-STOICHKOV SAYS WILL NOT PLAY FOR BULGARIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-STOICHKOV SAYS WILL NOT PLAY FOR BULGARIA.

text.p: Volatile striker Hristo Stoichkov, who has not turned up for Bulgaria's World Cup qualifiers so far, said he would not play against Cyprus on April 2, it was reported on Sunday.
Stoichkov quit the team last year demanding the resignation of the country's soccer chiefs.
"They (soccer chiefs) are now sending me a telegram to return but I will not do it," local media quoted Stoichkov as saying.
